requiredFiles.evidence: Five HTML variants, CSS, JS, design record, generation manifest, validation report, and three declared assets exist.

canonicalDimensions.evidence: Portrait and landscape viewports are 390x844 and 1024x768 CSS pixels; fullscreen raster backgrounds are exact 3x/2x exports at 1170x2532 and 2048x1536.

sourceContentParity.evidence: Brand, tagline, three social actions, two email actions, and linked legal copy match the captured page content.

semanticControls.evidence: All actions are native buttons; terms and privacy are links; labels remain live selectable text.

layoutLock.evidence: Invariant centered card, stacked social actions, equal email columns, top-left brand and legal-copy hierarchy are encoded in shared CSS.

localOnlyHtml.evidence: HTML references only local CSS, JS, and PNG files; no remote URLs, canvas, base64, or screenshot-as-UI.

orientationRecomposition.evidence: Portrait and landscape use distinct artwork compositions selected by orientation while preserving card geometry.

lightDarkParity.evidence: Fixed light/dark variants share the same DOM, CSS, assets, positioning and crop; dark mode changes tokens and overlay only.

darkContentContrast.evidence: Dark mode defines explicit readable text, muted copy, neutral/provider/action button surfaces, borders, legal-link color, hover, focus, and disabled treatments above the artwork mask.

themeNeutralArtwork.evidence: Accepted artwork contains no sun, moon, stars, night sky, sunrise, or sunset signals.

artworkNonInterference.evidence: Background is a CSS layer behind semantic content and cannot intercept pointer input.

naturalSceneLogic.evidence: Bird feet rest visibly on connected branches; flowers and mushrooms grow from meadow soil; no props float or fuse with foliage.

styleConsistency.evidence: Both assets share the same bird identity, watercolor/gouache texture, palette, foliage, daisies, mushrooms and diffuse lighting.

generationProvenance.evidence: Both new raster backgrounds were produced with built-in image_gen and no credentials.

responsiveThemeToggle.evidence: Responsive source selects artwork through orientation CSS and provides a visible keyboard-operable theme toggle.
